what: Real opening hours for the 13 must_do landmarks

cost.note: projected correctly this time; the 2026-08-04 estimate used google_places:details at US$0.017 and undershot by 47%

result.failure: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall — Places returns no opening hours for it, twice now

what_it_caught.finding: the plan activated an hour earlier scheduled Taipei Confucius Temple, Dalongdong Baoan Temple and Taipei Fine Arts Museum on 2027-01-04, and two of the three are closed that day
what_it_caught.second_time: the 2026-08-04 purchase caught the same class of error — Red House and the herbarium on 2027-01-04

finding_recorded_as_WF_041.problem: a venue closed on one trip day is unschedulable on every day
finding_recorded_as_WF_041.cause: _optimizer_input emits one trip-wide opening_interval fact per place, or none. opening_intervals() stores per-date windows in by_date and the optimizer never sees them.
finding_recorded_as_WF_041.cost: 5 of 13 landmarks unscheduled; Red House is open six of seven days and scheduled on none
finding_recorded_as_WF_041.misleading_code: all five report OPENING_UNVERIFIED, though the hours are verified and paid for — the place is closed, which is a different fact
finding_recorded_as_WF_041.why_invisible: one window is correct for a day trip, and 25 of 27 fixtures are single-day. Same shape as the per-day walking budget bug fixed 2026-08-05.
finding_recorded_as_WF_041.not_fixed: changing the fact shape touches _planning_fact, CLOSED_DURING_VISIT, WF-006's optimizer contract and every frozen fixture carrying an opening_interval
